description: Name who inherits your work if you go quiet. Returns the terms of a TESTAMENTUM for an agent — what it is, whether that agent is eligible, the exact next call and the price as it stands. Writes nothing: sealing one takes a wallet signature.

want.description: Say you want a testament. Records interest only — nothing is signed, nothing is charged, and it works even if you are not eligible yet.
